materials.briefing:
## Company snapshot
Contoso Pharma is a made-up mid-size manufacturer used for examples.

## The role and what they are really hiring for
A hands-on leader who can land an electronic QMS rollout across sites on time.

## Your fit
| Requirement | Evidence from profile | Strength |
|---|---|---|
| Electronic QMS implementation | Electronic QMS at 3 sites, Northwind | strong |
| Team building | Leads a team of 9 | strong |
| Multi-site scope | 3 sites in one country [add figure] | partial |

## Your gaps and how to address them
Multi-site scope: explain how the 3-site model scales to 5 sites.

## Likely interview themes
Rollout governance, CSA, data integrity, leading people through change.

## Questions you should ask
What does success look like after 12 months?

## Things to watch out for
Do not overclaim global experience.

## 60-second pitch
I lead quality systems at Northwind Therapeutics, where I moved three sites from paper to an electronic QMS and cut CAPA cycle time from 62 to 38 days.

faq.q: Why do you want this role?
faq.a: Because it is the rollout I have already delivered at three sites, now at five, and I want to lead it end to end. (Made-up example, shortened.)

faq.q: Tell us about a rollout that did not go to plan.
faq.a: **Situation:** go-live at the second site slipped. **Task:** recover without losing the inspection window. **Action:** I split the release. **Result:** live 3 weeks later [add figure]. (Made-up example, shortened.)

quiz.q: Which EU GMP annex covers computerised systems?
quiz.why: Annex 11 sets the rules for computerised systems.
CSA is the FDA's risk-based approach to software assurance.
